description: This file defines a mock class GlibWrapperMock for the IGlibWrapper interface, used for unit testing GObject/GLib related functionalities in the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for various GLib functions and handles mock behavior for functions that cannot be directly mocked, such as variadic functions.
